verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation is itself a Linux host, so this story fits awkwardly. Its marketing does show ways to run separate Linux environments inside it for development: VMs via Boxes, plus 'high-efficiency tools for creating, running and managing containers' with Red Hat container tooling and single-command access to tools and runtimes. The evidence is thin homepage copy, though, and never describes a full Linux terminal environment running on a non-Linux host. missing for 10: evidence of running a Fedora environment inside another host OS (e.g. Windows/macOS), concrete docs on containerized dev environments (e.g. toolbox), independent or hands-on corroboration.
